prelaunch_updates.text: DAC Chain: the reported Sat 11/21 6 PM CT (11/22 00:00 UTC) TGE passed with no announcement, time, venue or token address from @dac_chain (no posts since Fri 11/20). A third-party post claims the 11/22 date was removed from the vesting repo and TGE is now 'to be announced' (rumor, unconfirmed). Any DACT token now trading is not official; treat 'DACT TGE is live' and checker links as scams.

Flop Labs (reply, Sat 11/21): the homepage form is now called 'register interest'; it is not an application and grants nothing. Miner slots are not capped, but onboarding will be throttled to keep the network stable. Testnet/airdrop still Tue 11/24 (tentative). No token exists; any FLOP token is a scam.

DAC Chain: at noon Sat 11/21 @dac_chain still had not posted a TGE time, venue or token address for the reported Sat 11/21 6 PM CT date. Random accounts are sharing 'DACT airdrop checker' and 'mainnet portal' links that DAC has not published; treat them as likely phishing and never connect a wallet. Any DACT token before an official token address is unconfirmed.

DAC Chain: community posts now say the team called the widely shared TGE date (Sun 11/22 00:00 UTC = Sat 11/21 6 PM CT) an internal GitHub planning window, not an announcement, and that no date is set until exchanges confirm. @dac_chain itself has posted nothing on a TGE, venue or token address. Treat any DACT token or 'TGE live' post as unconfirmed.

DAC Chain's reported TGE (Sat 11/21 6 PM CT) is now less than 24 hours away and @dac_chain still has not posted a time, venue or token address. Community posts say the team is waiting on exchange confirmations and does not want to announce a date it might change, and that the AMA has slipped more than once (unconfirmed, not from DAC). Treat any DACT token as unconfirmed until DAC posts the official token address.
Quip testnet passed 100,000 blocks; the team repeats that the only major step left before mainnet is an external chain audit. Mainnet and TGE remain undated; no QUIP token exists yet.
Verona teased verUSD: 'verUSD is on its way. Our biggest launch yet is next.' No date, mechanics, backing or token address published. Any verUSD token before an official Verona post is a scam.

OPEN CAMPAIGN (founder): Arthur Hayes says the Flop testnet/airdrop is four days away (Tue 11/24, tentative) and that mainnet FLOP tokens will go to users who give useful, constructive feedback on X and GitHub about the network's policy choices. Criteria, amounts and how rewards are claimed are not published. No token exists yet; any FLOP token is a scam.

Flop Labs released CLI v0.7.0/v0.7.1 and Python SDK v0.3.3 and added a public validator/RPC operator application form on GitHub (one per team; a testnet application only records interest until testnet intake is announced; never post keys). Node operators only.

TermiX: holders of a Binance Agent ID can install TermiX Skills through their linked agent and connect its Agentic Wallet for 50 TP (TermiX points), one reward per wallet. A new task inside the existing points campaign; TGE still undated, any TMT token now is a scam.
